claimScope: Post-exposure fixed-candidate reproducibility in the recorded replay environment. Not a historical pre-exposure freeze, new holdout, independent statistical sample, model-promotion approval or release certification.

priorFindingDisposition.SPEC-1: Original historical limitation remains; eligible for operational closure under the explicitly qualified reproducibility claim only after verified completion.

completionConditions: Complete separately named replay with reviewed source hashes unchanged; any driver/wrapper delta needs review before replay. Use ordinary Python with assertions enabled, not -O/PYTHONOPTIMIZE.

Require successful driver exit AND confirmation-complete/receipt.json AND confirmation-complete/resolved-lineage.json. The base receipt is written before final driver assertions, so its presence alone is not success.

Independently compare original reference bindings, all copied input digests, selected records/metrics and replay lineage fields; verify exact heldout equality, full paired PGN/decision/outcome equality, expected game/model counts and unchanged runtime/opponent identities. Do not rely solely on receipt booleans.
Preserve original and failed/incomplete confirmation attempts under distinct names; no retuning, changed candidates, labels, thresholds or replacement of original receipts.

Before publishing claims, amend provenance documentation to identify tools/v8_confirm_complete.py and confirmation-complete evidence explicitly. nonblockingNotes: The qualification and failed-attempt preservation narrative are appropriate. The documentation pointer needs the complete driver/output names before evidence publication.
Identity checks prove equality at recorded boundaries, not continuous anti-tamper protection or full OS/shared-library hermeticity; keep claims to recorded reproducibility.
excluded: Heavy replay was not launched by this review; no running outputs or receipts were polled/read.
